fields: This file requires a newer version of Anki.

Ankidrone Essentials is an Anki deck for beginner Japanese learners. The deck was created using sentences extracted from JLPT Tango textbooks. When there was no example sentence for a word in the textbooks, the example sentence was sourced from elsewhere. For a small number of words there are no example sentences, they are formatted as SWC. Other cards are formatted as TSC.

This deck is meant to be used with the AJATT method of language learning. It assumes that you are immersing in Japanese media, mining sentences and studying Japanese grammar on your own.

We recommend this deck if you want to:
  • Learn basic Japanese vocabulary to increase your comprehension,
  • To supplement the process of sentence mining,
  • Or to expand your sentence bank.
We don't recommend this deck if you're not doing AJATT.

Ankidrone Essentials contains all vocabulary from the original Tango books. Therefore, while studying the deck you will find cards that you may not be interested in, for example:
  • Names of various places and countries. They are very specific and most likely were included in the books to teach people how to introduce themselves.
  • Katakana-words, loan-words. Most people who speak English can already understand them intuitively.
If you want, suspend such cards by pressing @ or delete them by pressing Ctrl+Delete.

昨日彼がぶらっと立ち寄った。
He dropped in on me yesterday. {CHECKED}

昨日は全くついていなかった。
It just was not my day yesterday.

彼がきのうそこにいたはずはない。
He cannot have been there yesterday.

きのう彼に電話をかけたのは私だった。
It was I that phoned him yesterday.

彼らは、昨日魚釣りに行きました。
They went fishing yesterday.

「ウィキペディアを引用するな」という主張が昨日だか一昨日だかの朝日新聞に載っていた。
The exhortation "Don't quote Wikipedia" was included in the Asahi newspaper of yesterday or the day before. {CHECKED}

おとといそこへ行きました。
I went there the day before yesterday.

一昨日成田に着きました。
I arrived at Narita the day before yesterday.

一昨日、彼らはそこを出発した。
They left there the day before yesterday.

その火事はおととい発生した。
A fire broke out the day before yesterday.

ヘレンは昨年日本に来た。
Helen came to Japan last year. {CHECKED}

実は、私たちは昨年結婚しました。
To tell the truth, we got married last year.

昨年の主な出来事は何でしたか。
What were the chief events of last year?

彼は昨年遺書を。
He made a will last year.

私は昨年退職しました。
I retired last year.
